text:
SRE Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: tenant_sla_breach_check for tenant=SilverGate in prod-east triggered (P1). 5m breach window exceeded, SLA error rate 6.4% (>5%). Paging eng-oncall.
SRE Bot: link: https://console.internal/alerts/tenant_sla_breach_check?s=SilverGate

Maria H: ack. I'm on it. pulling logs and checking dashboard.

Ashwin P: reading the dashboard — the spike started ~09:12 UTC and is mostly 503/timeout errors from the embed-backend pool serving SilverGate. Could be a noisy retry loop.

Devon (oncall): repro attempt: curl against embed endpoint for silvergate-prod tenant returns 503 consistently, reproducing locally from prod-east infra. attaching snippet:
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
x-request-id: r-9f3a
{"error":"model overloaded"}
```

Priya K: SilverGate on Dedicated plan with soft-SLA alerting. They did a bulk ingest job earlier today? Ops said they had a migration at 07:00 but should be done.

Ashwin P: @Devon can you check routing -> the requests are getting shunted to a lower-capacity GPU cluster (quantized variant) after some kernel OOMs. Might be a fallback loop.

Devon (oncall): checking instance logs now. Confirmed rapid scale attempts plus fallback to smaller model variant. See kube events:
```
kubectl -n inference logs pod/embed-xyz | tail -n 50
E OOM while allocating kv-cache
W fallback to model-quantized-v2
```

Maria H: immediate mitigation: silencing tenant-specific pager for SilverGate for 30m while we investigate to prevent page flood. Executing silence now.

Devon (oncall): silenced via alertmanager: `curl -XPOST $ALERTMGR/api/v2/silences -d '{"matchers":[{"name":"tenant","value":"SilverGate","isRegex":false}],"startsAt":"2026-03-15T09:24:00Z","endsAt":"2026-03-15T09:54:00Z","createdBy":"oncall","comment":"live mitigation - noisy tenant cascade"}'`

SRE Bot: silence created (ID: s-9a7b). Alerts will still be recorded but won't page.

Ops:jon: good call. Also recommend creating a temporary rate-limit on SilverGate's heavy route to stop retry storms. Suggest 10 rps burst cap.

Ashwin P: agreed. Adding a temporary ingress rule on the gateway:
```
patch /gateway/routes/silvergate limit: 10rps
```

Priya K: Please coordinate with support — we need to call SilverGate PM and let them know we throttled their traffic to avoid SLA breach propagation.

Maria H: Support notified @silvergate-contact (email + pager) — they confirm a background job kicked off unthrottled. They're pausing it.

Devon (oncall): after throttle and silence, error rate dropped to 1.2% in 2 minutes. pushing a quick dashboard for postmortem: `#/dashboards/tenant/silvergate-sla` created.

Ashwin P: Post-incident actions (PID):
- Create tenant-scoped check that ignores transient 503 bursts caused by fallback loops (threshold: 5m sustained AND >3% errors) — current rule uses 1m window.
- Add quiesce policy: automatically reduce retries for tenant after consecutive backend 503s.
- Add a graph comparing routing fallback counts to error rate.

Priya K: also we should tune alert priority: move tenant_sla_breach_check to warn for non-enterprise tenants; SilverGate is enterprise so keep P1 but add automatic escalation only if sustained 15m.

Maria H: created quick issue: INC-4829 "silvergate: tenant-specific alert surgery and retry-quash" and assigned to eng-runtime + product.

Devon (oncall): leaving notes for handoff — I'm going offline at 10:00 UTC. Next oncall please monitor the silence expiry and the new gateway limit. Steps in the runbook:
1) confirm silence still active: `GET $ALERTMGR/api/v2/silences/s-9a7b`
2) if breach resumes after throttle removal, re-escalate and rollback quota.
3) gather `kv-cache` OOM pod logs and upload to INC-4829.

Ashwin P: @Priya K can you follow up with SilverGate CS to schedule a post-ops call and get their ingestion job details? We need exact throughput numbers to recommend a lasting quota.

Priya K: will do, will CC eng-runtime. Also adding a note to the SLA tracker that we performed a temporary throttle under customer coop — keep for audit.

Maria H: going to run through alert rules now and propose config diff. current rule snippet:
```
- alert: tenant_sla_breach_check
  expr: sum(rate(errors_total{tenant=\"SilverGate\"}[1m])) / sum(rate(requests_total{tenant=\"SilverGate\"}[1m])) > 0.05
  for: 1m
```
Proposed change for tenant-scoped tuning:
```
for: 5m
expr: sum(rate(errors_total{tenant=\"SilverGate\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(requests_total{tenant=\"SilverGate\"}[5m])) > 0.03
labels: {severity: \"page\"}
```

Devon (oncall): +1. Also add `fallback_count` suppression condition: only page if fallback_count < 10 in the window (means it's not a cascading fallback event we already handle).

SRE Bot: NOTE: filed post-incident runbook entry. Follow-up tasks: INC-4829 assigned, dashboard added, silence recorded, gateway patch rolled, support notified.

Maria H: handing off to @Devon for the next 30 minutes then to next rotation. Tagging next oncall in calendar.

Ops:jon: adding small follow-up: we should automate tenant-level temporary silences via API when we detect >5 correlated alerts for same tenant in 2m.

Ashwin P: agreed — creating RFC in repo `infra/alerting` for "tenant flood auto-squelch". Will link to INC-4829.

Priya K: thanks team. summary: immediate throttle + silence mitigated the page storm, created dashboard + ticket, next steps are alert tuning (increase for sustained windows, add fallback_count suppression), customer follow-up. Closing thread once postmortem doc is up.

Maria H: closing thread here, moving to postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
